description: Electricité - Données géographiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Paris. Vector type data, describing certain electrical furniture: electric vehicle terminals, low voltage sockets.\ Example(s) of data reuse(s):\, Android app “VuzZz” Google Link Play. Coverage: Ville de Paris. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity — Geographical data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Paris. Its keywords include equipements, paris, voiture-electrique, mobilier-urbain. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, JSON, XLS, SHP. The listing shows 2016-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
